prompt:
Use case: neutral educational photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 头; subject ID head only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych with exactly three independent horizontal landscape portraits stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Subject: the same generic wholly synthetic AI adult in all three panels, not based on any real person, with ordinary short dark hair and a plain gray crew-neck shirt covering torso and shoulders. Neutral anonymized educational portrait, no named identity or permission claims.
Top photograph: direct front view of the person's complete head, including the entire hair outline, crown, both ears, face and chin, with a little neck and fully clothed shoulders. Calm neutral expression, eyes naturally open, mouth closed.
Middle photograph: true side profile of the same adult's complete head, facing to one side, clearly showing crown, forehead, nose, chin, ear and back of head. Neutral expression, same hair and clothing; not a three-quarter view.
Bottom photograph: direct rear view of the same adult's complete head, showing the entire crown and back of the short hair, ears and nape above the same shirt collar. No face visible in the rear view.
Composition/framing: three standalone wide landscape portraits in exact front, side, back order, full head centered in each panel with at least 12 percent clear crop-safe space above the hair, beside the silhouette and below the chin or nape. Clothed shoulders may extend toward the lower frame edge; never crop hair, ears or chin. Simple warm pale neutral backdrop, consistent comfortable camera distance and natural adult anatomy.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic synthetic portrait photography, natural skin texture, ordinary fine hairs and fabric texture, soft window daylight with believable shadows and realistic colors. No glamour styling, cartoon, illustration or mannequin appearance.
Constraints: fully clothed neutral adult; no real identities, celebrities, identifying accessories, nudity, sexualized framing, injury or gore. Exactly three panels and two white seams. No writing, labels, letters, numbers, logos, brands, captions, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. Three consistent short-haired synthetic adult portraits in a plain gray crew-neck shirt show complete head front, true side profile facing right, and direct rear view in the requested order. Expressions are neutral; warm plain backdrop, natural-looking skin, hair and shirt texture. Hair, ears and chin or nape are intact; upper hair margins are smaller than requested 12 percent, while clothed shoulders intentionally reach the lower panel edges. No visible writing, logos, watermark or identifying accessories at preview resolution; fine skin details are not verified. Sharp measured white seam rows 593–600 and 1180–1188 in the 1024x1792 original; rounded centers 597 and 1184. Panel heights differ slightly.
